problem_statement: Rich syntax highlighting omits the token stream for a requested line range. Syntax.highlight() must iterate the Pygments lexer token sequence and preserve line-range token fragments so highlighted source remains visible.
transfer_rationale: Rich's Syntax.highlight() consumes a structured lexer token sequence and splits token text into line-range fragments, related to GS-T005 source annotation token iteration but in a different repository and concrete implementation.
notes: GS-E003 hardened-development-v1; preregistered and not treatment-run
